provenance.note: Coefficients copied at full precision from img/frontier_ce_gain/raw.json (data.coefficients; equal to exp/raw of deep_vec/loop_vec in img/reducible_vs_compute/raw.json). Fitted window = min/max over the 144 sparse-grid endpoints (deep_rows + loop_rows) of flops_per_token F, sparsity S, tokens D = training_compute / F, and training_compute C. Scale anchors = mean Baseline F per scale over the three sparsity buckets. Horizons = the six token counts D (rounded to whole tokens). Default = the 1.6B, S~97% (es42) Baseline endpoint with the longest horizon. Nothing is fitted or downsampled here; the page evaluates Eq. (3) itself. gammaBootstrap = gamma.base / gamma.loop ci95 and gamma.prob_loop_higher from bootstrap_gamma_ce_gain.json (cell bootstrap, 2,000 draws), unchanged.

form: L(F, S, D) = E + A*(1-S)^b/F^a + K/D^c; b fixed per architecture, fitted separately per architecture
